notes.title: The final build before launch!
notes.content:
[b]Changed Content[/b]
[list]
[*] The button to progress text was displayed in strange places during messages reading, it is now always centered and at the bottom of the text box. Message boxes have been moved higher up on screen to prevent the progress text key going off-screen during longer messages
[*] Badgers no longer shoot when sign post text is on screen
[*] Screenshake on landing and shooting was slightly too much, decreased
[*] A lot of text had an ellipsis followed by a space, this didn’t look right. The space has been removed
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] The Streets mini-game bullet hell could be cheesed by perfectly standing between bullets. This has been fixed by decreasing the gap between bullets and increasing the number of total bullets to fill the remaining space
[*] Fixed some signpost typos
[*] Minor typo tweak on the bonus display of the Streets mini-game
[/list]

notes.title: TurtleRun launches March 7th
notes.content:
It's been one heck of a journey but in just under one week, the project I've poured so much passion and time into over the past year of learning game development will finally release.

Adding the game to your wishlist will mean you get notified when the game goes live and can take advantage of the launch sale.

Thanks so much for the support and I look forward to many future releases!

[previewyoutube=AoVnG3Zvuyg;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Build 2.2.0-a now live
notes.content:
[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Added support for German localisation
[*] Added a language picker menu option
[*] Added profanity filter, bad names will be replaced with “Shellonymous”
[/list]

[b]Changed Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed the toggle fullscreen option, the game now plays in borderless windowed
[*] Changed the colour of the turtle mouth when shooting from white to salmon
[*] Updated the walking sound effect
[*] 4-2 the bouncy platform section wasn’t placed properly, making it too challenging, resolved
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would launch in a small borderless window if the player clicked away between launch and load
[*] Fixed a display issue on the menu
[*] Audio settings were saving the wrong way around - sfx equaled music and vice versa, this has been fixed
[/list]

notes.title: Build 2.1.0-a now live
notes.content:
[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Volume and vibration settings are now saved between sessions
[*] Added a sound effect for when the player lands
[*] Added a sound effect for switching between menu options
[*] Added a sound effect for switching between keys on the name creation screen
[*] Added a sound effect for transition between levels
[*] Added “+1” text when score is increased on the Streets mini-game
[*] New achievements added to the game
[list][*] Mushroom Mastery - Defeat the Woodlands boss with all lives intact[/list]
[list][*] Tidal Triumph - Defeat the Beach boss with all lives intact[/list]
[list][*] Litter Legend - Defeat the Streets boss with all lives intact[/list]
[list][*] Electro Expert - Defeat the Pond boss with all lives intact[/list]
[list][*] Cold Blooded - Defeat all enemies[/list]
[list][*] Shell Stocked - Gather all collectibles[/list]
[list][*] Total Shellout - Defeat all enemies and gather all collectibles[/list]
[list][*] Scaled Sage - Interact with all signposts[/list]
[/list]
[b]Changed Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Replaced the Woodlands boss theme with an Aly Mac song written for TurtleRun
[*] Replaced the Streets boss theme with the old Woodlands boss theme
[*] Made bullet collection automatic instead of after pressing a button
[*] Made bullet and parry collection non-skippable
[*] On the Beach mini-game - reduced the time that shells are open to make the game feel more fluid
[*] Mini-games now automatically proceed to the boss encounter if the max score was achieved, rather than asking the player if they want to replay or proceed
[*] Boss encounter no longer offer the option to replay the mini-game if the max score was already achieved
[*] Changed badger bullet speed from 4 to 3, changed big badger bullet speed from 7 to 6
[*] Changed the turtle collision mask so that the player is walking higher up on the platforms
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the pause menu could disappear and be unrecoverable
[*] Fixed a bug that was causing load game to land on the incorrect level
[*] Fixed a bug where if they played was holding shoot during the death animation, the shooting mouth would appear
[*] Stopped vibration persisting between levels if the player fell off the map immediately after completing the level
[*] Stopped vibration during the retry screen after dying on a boss encounter
[/list]

[list]

[list][*]There was an issue where if a boss was retried, the remaining mini-games would not play, this has been fixed[/list]

notes.title: Build 1.9.0-a now live
notes.content:
[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*]A Lives/Health system has been implemented on boss encounters. The player will now have 3 lives, represented by hearts. Upon running out of lives, the player will be given the option to try again with the same bonus damage modifier as they currently have, or to replay the mini-game for another shot at achieving a higher bonus damage modifier.
[*]Added a menu option to restart the current level
[/list]

[b]Changed Content[/b]
[list]
[*]Previously, a parried bullet would hit only the Pond boss for increased damage, this has been changed to deal increased damage to all bosses.
[*]With the introduction of the lives system and the increased parry damage, boss health required tweaking. These values may need future changes to achieve balance
[list][*]Woodlands boss HP increased from 150 to 200[/list]
[list][*]Beach boss HP increased from 500 to 650[/list]
[list][*]Streets boss HP increased from 1500 to 2000[/list]
[list][*]Pond boss HP increased from 600 to 800[/list]
[*]Due to the recently added autosave feature, the menu options to save are no longer required, they have been removed
[*]Moved “Paused” text higher on screen when game paused to not interfere with longer menu options
[*]It felt weird having “Elims: N/A” on the scoresheet after a boss fight, collectibles and “Elims” removed from boss fight scoresheets
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*]General
[list][*]Turtle was elevated between level screens, moved back to correct position[/list]
[list][*]Larger bullets like the ones used by bosses were a bit offset when colliding with walls and switching to the hitspark, this has been adjusted for a cleaner look[/list]
[list][*]Adjusted a couple of unfair jumps[/list]
[*]Streets
[list][*]During the Bullet Hell mini-game of the Streets zone, the player could cheese it by standing to the far right and not getting hit, bullet spacing has been adjusted to resolve this[/list]
[list][*]During the Streets boss encounter, the timer did not stay green when the level started[/list]
[*]Pond
[list][*]On level 4-2 there was an issue with a checkpoint returning the player to an area where they could no longer ride the moving platform, added another moving platform to resolve[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Build 1.8.3-a now live
notes.content:
[b]New Content[/b]
[list]
[*] Controller players can now use the d-pad throughout the game and menus. This means that due to mismatching preferences.ini files, player keybind preferences have been reset. Added a system message to advise and give instruction on changing
[*] Added controller vibration on shoot, collect, parry and death
[list][*] Added a menu option to toggle vibration on and off, defaults to On[/list]
[*] GUI updates
[list][*] The level now shows in the bottom right instead of top right[/list]
[list][*] Current kills and collectibles found are now tracked and show the total number available, e.g. 4 / 7. This text will turn green and play a sound when all enemies or collectibles have been killed/found. An additional sound is played when both targets have been met[/list]
[list][*] The timer now starts off Green and turns white once the S-tier time for the current level has elapsed[/list]
[*] Audio
[list][*] Added Audio Controls to the options menu to allow configuring of music and sound effects volume[/list]
[list][*] More sound effects added[/list]
[list][*] Player death[/list]
[list][*] Signpost text[/list]
[list][*] All enemies killed[/list]
[list][*] All collectibles found[/list]
[list][*] All enemies killed and all collectibles found[/list]
[*]Added a Credits menu where the link to HeatleyBros youtube channel now lives, more credits to follow
[/list]
[b]Changed Content[/b]
[list]
[*] General
[list][*] The game will now autosave after every level has been completed[/list]
[list][*] Some jumps have been nerfed to reduce unfairness[/list]
[list][*] Spike collision masks reduced in size to feel more fair and not cause deaths where the player doesn’t think they’ve hit the spike[/list]
[list][*] It wasn’t obvious which platforms were “crumbling” platforms until the player landed on it, now, the sprite of crumbling platforms shows the first step of the crumble by default[/list]
[list][*] Save files are now deleted upon game completion to prevent loading and writing multiple entries to the leaderboard for the same run[/list]
[list][*] New music after killing a boss[/list]
[list][*] New music after completing the game[/list]
[list][*] The dark green colour commonly used to text elements has been lightened[/list]
[list][*] Changed wording from “KOs” to “Elims” on the end of level score screen[/list]
[*] Woodlands
[list][*] 1-3: Extended a platform so the player no longer has to leap of faith possibly to their death[/list]
[*] Streets
[list][*] Updated the room between levels in the Streets zone to contain the updated tileset[/list]
[list][*] 2-3: Updated the signpost text to show the buttons required to perform a downwards jump[/list]
[*] Pond
[list][*] The boss felt a bit too vulnerable, especially with max damage bonus modifier, boss health has been increased from 500 to 600[/list]
[list][*] Snails took too long to attack, this timer has been reduced from 180ms to 120 ms[/list]
[list][*] During the spot the difference mini-game, the time each item spent on screen before being hidden was harsh, this has been increased by 50%[/list]
[list][*] This zone was lacking collectibles, more have been added[/list]
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Another attempt has been made at the “getting stuck in the side of platforms” issue, hopefully it’s resolved now
[*] Previously if you loaded game, your name was not written to the leaderboard upon completion - this has been resolved
[*] A bug was discovered where the Parry Hotter achievement could be unlocked through one enemy shooting another, this has been resolved.
[*] Fixed an issue where if the player’s controller disconnected on the menu screen, the game broke. Note: There is still frame drop when a bluetooth controller connects or disconnects, this is a known issue with Game Maker and cannot be helped, see https://github.com/YoYoGames/GameMaker-Bugs/issues/5389 for more information
[*] Beach mini-game walls were the wrong sprite
[/list]
